tracks.aggregation: equal weight across four workflows, according to publisher
tracks.export_status: Browsable examples verified; complete versioned cases, executable harness, reference tensors and scorer not located in the inspected public pages/repositories

tracks.reference_kind: human-adjudicated outcomes plus executable checks where possible

tracks.jev_track: fixed ASR/OCR or visual-description preprocessing plus Jev; measure preprocessing failures, latency and cost
tracks.oracle_transcript_track: diagnostic ceiling only, distinct from deployable pipeline

engineering_smoke.purpose: credential, primitive, cost, failure and policy plumbing only

required_for_same_frontier: same versioned cases and input information
same reference source and scoring implementation
same input track and preprocessing policy
same concurrency and client-visible latency boundary
complete results including unsupported inputs, failures and retries
actual API input usage or allocated self-hosted serving cost per completed workflow
separate quality-cost, quality-latency and joint Pareto analyses
paired family-level uncertainty intervals before declaring a gain

test_firewall.published_examples: diagnosis only; never count as fresh confirmation
test_firewall.training: separate licensed sources and development workflows
test_firewall.confirmation: fresh grouped cases; freeze checkpoint, prompts, policy and thresholds before opening labels

next_model_gate.name: MiSO language-capable candidate
next_model_gate.approach: Compare compact pretrained language backbones and direct typed decision heads before a larger multimodal training run
